description: This file defines the Core Data managed object class `NoteEntity` for persisting note data, including properties like id, title, content, timestamps, and sync status. It also provides a fetch request method for retrieving `NoteEntity` instances.

classes.name: NoteEntity
classes.description: A Core Data managed object representing a note with various properties such as id, title, content, timestamps, and synchronization status.

methods.name: fetchRequest
methods.description: Returns an `NSFetchRequest` for fetching `NoteEntity` instances from Core Data.
